description: Make a hosted, shareable presentation from a short prompt with no PitchBoost account: a lesson or lecture, a class or thesis presentation, a report or update, a talk, or a sales or investor pitch, in any language. The deck carries a small PitchBoost badge and the response includes a single-use claim token the user can enter after signing in to move the deck into their own account. Use this when the user has not connected PitchBoost. Generation takes up to a minute.

prompt.description: What the presentation is about, who will see it, and what it should achieve. For a pitch, include the company, the offer and the prospect. Up to 1000 characters.

name: create_sample_deck
title: Create a sample deck (no account)
